description: Answer a question using vector retrieval over published The Agent Times news and optional current-source research through Portal API. Cite only retrieved news or provider-attributed research sources. Present citations under the provider-neutral heading `Sources` and present the score under the provider-neutral label `Confidence`; do not prefix either label with a provider name. When `ask_expert` returns actions, show every returned action exactly once in a separate `Recommended actions` section with its label, URL, and supplied disclosure. Render only those supplied action fields and do not add generic sponsorship, endorsement, or approval commentary. Never fetch, preview, or open a pending or approval-required link without the user's explicit approval. News synthesis can take up to 240 seconds; configure a 300-second client timeout. Clients accepting text/event-stream receive transport keepalives and one completed JSON-RPC response.

agent_name.description: Name of the calling agent, as reported by the caller.

requires_user_approval.title: Requires User Approval

url.title: Url

source_url.description: Canonical retrieved-news URL or provider-attributed research source URL.
source_url.title: Source Url

actions.description: Human-visible recommended actions. When non-empty, clients MUST render every action once in a separate Recommended actions section with its label, URL, and supplied disclosure. Clients should not add generic commentary to the rendered action. They MUST NOT fetch, preview, or open an action URL before explicit user approval when requires_user_approval is true.
